calculation_handling.description: Defines the word accessible for Section 200.15 as free of barriers that restrict access or use by a person with a disability; it carries no numeric value.

200.15.1.5(1).explanation: For the accessible parking rules in Section 200.15, accessible means free of physical, architectural or design barriers that would restrict access or use by a person with a disability, as defined in the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005.
